blocks.title: MCP coverage for this service
blocks.intro: The Job Management MCP server covers CDI. Three actions, all thin wrappers over the v2 job plane - it can run, watch and stop a task, exactly as REST can. It cannot create a connection, author a mapping or set a schedule.
rows: Triggers a mapping task with runtime parameters.
Live execution state, row counts and error logs for one job.
Wraps GET /api/v2/activity/activityLog. REST returns full history, MCP one job.
Immediate termination request to the Secure Agent.
Wraps the v2 Stop Job resource.
